title: Margin shortage file to member (MCXCCL, MCX_MARGINSHORTAGE)
purpose: Each client's margins, the margin collected as reported, the shortfalls (peak, intraday and end-of-day short allocation) and the penalty levied for the trade date.
linked: Loaded as the margin shortfall and penalty MCXCCL worked out per client: shown on Clearing data, used as the levied penalty when no NCMR or UDiFF penalty file is loaded (passed to a client only through the pass-through rules)
source: MCXCCL File Formats, version 1, section 1.17 (Margin Shortage File to Member): MCX_MARGINSHORTAGE_<YYYYMMDD>_.Enn on the trading member's FTP folder, no column title row

columns.name: Client ID
columns.note: blank for ITCM/PCM; *OWN* for the firm's own positions

columns.name: Amount of Shortfall of Margins
columns.note: shortfall for the levy of penalty (option 1, 2 or 3 of the file description)
